name: IT Support Specialist

sections.daily_work: Help people with computer problems. Set up hardware and software. Troubleshoot network issues. Create documentation. Manage user accounts and security.
sections.learning: Operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux), networking basics, hardware troubleshooting, customer service skills, security fundamentals (CompTIA A+, Network+).
sections.pay: Entry-level typically starts around $35,000-$55,000 USD. Mid-level $50,000-$75,000. Senior or specialized roles can reach $80,000+. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Google IT Support Professional Certificate (Coursera), CompTIA A+ certification, associate degree in IT, help desk experience, self-study via free online resources.

try_in_real_life: Set up a virtual machine (try VirtualBox with a free Linux distro)
Help a friend or family member with a tech problem and document the steps
Take the free Google IT Support course on Coursera
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Outlook Handbook (bls.gov/ooh); CompTIA industry reports
